environment.brokerSelection: AGENTMUX_TEST_NATS selects the prepared disposable broker binary, never a live daemon

independentReview.scope: Read-only source and resource/fixture review, not phase acceptance

assertions: Observer succeeds with a principal restricted to account INFO, fixed stream INFO and existing MSG.GET.
Real publication and stream-creation attempts by that restricted principal receive actual permission denials.
Absent stream and missing requested record remain unknown; no publication, creation or repair follows.
Repeated existing-record observation preserves stream configuration, creation identity, record counts and sequence state.
Wrong credentials, domain, server name/version and unavailable endpoint cannot produce verified identity observations.
Malformed existing record or incompatible configuration is refused without changes.
Monitoring verifies owned NATS connections close after successful and failed observation.
A real withheld greeting obeys the earlier 75ms caller deadline.
Canceling after actual TCP acceptance interrupts setup in less than 500ms despite a five-second options timeout.
Live unselected endpoint and released-owner dialing are refused before TCP contact.
Result and error output contains no credentials, endpoint or raw private record bytes.
limits: Read-only observations do not prove current write permission, restart durability, protected-role readiness, application readiness or an atomic snapshot.
Writing deployment.Probe remains separate and must not be injected into the read-only doctor.
Private profile/release authority and bootstrap integration remain coordinator responsibilities.
Native macOS/Linux, actual Compose startup, full recovery and all phase criteria remain mandatory.
Earlier reported renderer-worker import/vet failure was not reproduced on the frozen current source; no unsupported cause is claimed.
Pattern checker still reports stale review while P02 source changes; coordinator owns final registration and review.
No other worker source files, global metadata or tracker were edited; no Docker operation, CI dispatch, commit, push, merge or release.
